lang.setbonus.elsewhere.single_combat.detail1: While exactly one hostile mob targets you: +10% damage dealt and -10% damage taken from mob attacks.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.single_combat.detail2: Needs all four Galeplate pieces. Never applies between players.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.hold_the_line.detail1: Sneak or raise a shield: +4 armor.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.hold_the_line.detail2: While you hold, allies within 4 blocks (players, your minions and pets) take 10% less damage.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.hold_the_line.detail3: Needs the Hearthguard helm, greaves and boots with Hrafnholt's Hearth-Ward Mail.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.greater_bond.detail1: Your 2-slot minions (War-Yak, Echo Reliquary) get +30% max health and deal +15% damage.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.greater_bond.detail2: Needs the Elderbark mantle, leggings and boots with the Elder Bark Crown.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.azmar_falconer.detail: Your arrow hits mark the target: your minions deal +15% to it for 4 s.
Your minions' hits mark it: your arrows deal +10% to it for 4 s.
Needs the Falconer Kilt with Azmar's Sandrunner Sandals. Scales with your Marksman and Summoner strength.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.azmar_glyphmail.detai: Melee hits make 1 Glimmer (once per 0.5 s).
Spells cast within 3 s of a melee hit cost 30% less Glimmer.
Needs the Glyphmail Hood and Hauberk. Scales with your Vanguard and Caster strength.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.hrafnholt_hird.detail: Herd focus is halved: each minion beyond the first costs you 5% damage, not 10%.
Your melee hits refresh your minions' battle timers.
Needs the Hird Leggings and Boots. Scales with your Vanguard and Summoner strength.
+6% spell power for each minion you have out (up to +24%).
Every spell you cast refreshes your minions' battle timers and heals each of them 2 health.
Needs the Lamplighter Hood and Coat. Scales with your Caster and Summoner strength.
